title: CRISIS: The Lights Go Off
text: Congress and the White House have been staring at each other for weeks. Nobody has picked up the phone. Federal workers have been told to stay home and wait.

options.label: Call both parties in and negotiate
options.result: You sat in a room with the other side for six hours. Nobody took a photo. The lights came back on.

ignore.text: The shutdown became the longest on record. A museum of it is being planned.

inspiredBy: The record federal shutdown of October to November 2025.

title: CRISIS: Air Traffic Gets Thin
text: Controllers are unpaid and calling in sick. Flights are being cut. Your own jet is fine, which is the only thing you checked.

options.label: Fund the controllers, quietly
options.result: You signed a boring funding line. Planes departed more or less on time, which nobody thanked you for.

ignore.text: Airlines cancelled the entire holiday season as a courtesy.

inspiredBy: Flight cuts and delays caused by air traffic staffing during the 2025 shutdown.

title: CRISIS: The Bond Market Sulks
text: Investors who lend the country money have started asking whether it is a good idea. Yields are up. So is a very quiet panic.

options.label: Reassure the lenders, dully
options.result: You read a statement with the word "sustainable" in it. The lenders went back to sleep.

ignore.text: The interest bill grew large enough to need its own zip code.

inspiredBy: The April 2025 rise in long-term Treasury yields during the tariff sell-off.

title: CRISIS: Wrong Person In The Chat
text: Someone on the team added a journalist to the plans group chat. It has been a very informative week for the journalist.

options.label: Fix the phones and the policy
options.result: You issued a memo about messaging apps. It was read by everyone, including the journalist.

ignore.text: The chat has been renamed "Public Briefing" by popular demand.

inspiredBy: The March 2025 Signal group chat episode with an accidentally added editor.

title: CRISIS: Please Come Back
text: The staff you fired turned out to look after something important. The agency is calling them back, politely, by email, with an apology template.

options.label: Rehire the staff, sheepishly
options.result: You approved the rehiring memo. It is titled "Restoring Efficiency". Nobody laughed on camera.

ignore.text: The agency is now run by one intern and a very confident printer.

inspiredBy: The February 2025 rehiring of nuclear security staff dismissed in federal cuts.

title: CRISIS: The Court Reads Your Tariffs
text: A court has looked at the legal basis for your tariffs and used the word "unlawful" in a footnote. Importers are holding their breath and their invoices.

options.label: Seek a lawful route to the same goal
options.result: Your lawyers found three statutes that do the job. All three require paperwork. You signed it.

ignore.text: The tariffs were refunded by a clerk with a very large rubber stamp.

inspiredBy: The 2025 and 2026 court challenges to emergency-powers tariffs.

title: CRISIS: Magnet Shortage
text: A major supplier has restricted exports of rare earth magnets. Factories are tapping their fridge doors for spares.

options.label: Talk to the supplier, patiently
options.result: You agreed to a truce and a reading of a spreadsheet. Factories got their magnets. You got no applause.

ignore.text: Carmakers began selling cars with a fridge magnet and a prayer.

inspiredBy: China's October 2025 rare earth export controls and the trade scramble that followed.

title: CRISIS: The Price Of Everything
text: Families are being told that dinner costs more than expected. A press aide has suggested you say "the economy is great" more loudly.

options.label: Address costs with an actual plan
options.result: You held a dull press conference on supply chains. Grocery prices wobbled in a pleasing direction.

ignore.text: Shoppers reportedly started paying for eggs with the gold leaf.

inspiredBy: Public frustration over grocery and living costs in 2025.

title: CRISIS: The Statistics Office Has No Boss
text: After a poor jobs report, the head of the statistics bureau was dismissed. Now nobody can find the numbers, and nobody trusts them.

options.label: Appoint someone credible, and stand back
options.result: You named a person who knows what a median is. The numbers returned, and so did the bad news.

ignore.text: The jobs report was replaced by a vibe, released on Fridays.

inspiredBy: The August 2025 dismissal of the labor statistics commissioner after a weak jobs report.

title: CRISIS: Neighbour Hangs Up
text: A trade call with your northern neighbour ended when a television ad annoyed you. The neighbour is now also annoyed. So is every border town.

options.label: Resume the talks, politely
options.result: You called back and apologised without using the word. The neighbour returned your calls and your lumber.

ignore.text: The border was repainted with the word "Hello" and nobody came.

inspiredBy: The October 2025 suspension of US-Canada trade talks over a political ad.

title: CRISIS: Breakfast Prices Spike
text: Tariffs on coffee and beef are now showing up in the one place you cannot gild: the breakfast table. Aides are calling it a "temporary adjustment".

options.label: Roll back the breakfast tariffs
options.result: You exempted coffee and beef by memo. Breakfast prices eased and nobody noticed you did it.

ignore.text: The nation switched to hot water and rumours.

inspiredBy: The 2025 tariffs on Brazilian goods and the later exemptions on coffee and beef.

title: CRISIS: Central Bank Standoff
text: You and the central bank are not speaking. Rates are a mood now. Markets are checking whether the independent bit is still independent.

options.label: Respect the bank, and keep quiet
options.result: You said "no comment" for a whole week. Financial markets nearly wept with joy.

ignore.text: The central bank moved to a building with a better lock.

inspiredBy: The 2025 and 2026 pressure on the Federal Reserve over interest rates and its leadership.

title: CRISIS: The Visa Fee Mix-Up
text: A new huge fee on skilled worker visas was announced at dinner and clarified at breakfast. Employers do not know whether to pay it, frame it or flee.

options.label: Publish clear rules, in small print
options.result: You issued two pages of rules, one of which was correct. Employers sighed and filed forms.

ignore.text: Seven hundred hiring managers started a support group.

inspiredBy: The September 2025 announcement of a $100,000 fee on H-1B visas and the confusion around it.

title: CRISIS: The Quad Turns Quiet
text: High tariffs on a large Asian partner have made a joint summit awkward. The empty chairs are being described as "scheduling".

options.label: Repair the partnership, in person
options.result: You made a phone call that included the word "partner". The chairs filled up. No one thanked you.

ignore.text: The summit was held without you, and also without a table.

inspiredBy: The 2025 US tariffs on India and the strain on the Quad partnership.

title: CRISIS: Frozen Real Estate
text: Your remarks about acquiring a large Arctic island have upset a small, polite country. Its leaders have started using the word "sovereign" a lot.

options.label: Reassure the allies, then retreat
options.result: You said you wanted "a framework". Nobody knew what it meant, but the polite country relaxed.

ignore.text: The island formally declared itself not for sale.

inspiredBy: The January 2026 row between the US and Denmark over Greenland.

title: CRISIS: The Meeting Goes Off Script
text: A visiting leader and you have exchanged views in front of the cameras. The aides have left the room. The cameras have not.

options.label: Rebuild the relationship after the fact
options.result: You issued a joint statement that said nothing very kindly. Everyone relaxed.

ignore.text: The visitor left by a side door, and the side door was named.

inspiredBy: The February 2025 Oval Office meeting with Ukraine's president that ended in a public clash.

title: CRISIS: The Parcel Pile-Up
text: You ended the small-parcel customs exemption. Postal services abroad stopped shipping to America. Millions of packages are piled in a depot.

options.label: Fix the customs rules, tediously
options.result: You issued a rule on parcel forms. Mail resumed. Customs staff now use your name as a verb.

ignore.text: The packages became a national monument to waiting.

inspiredBy: The August 2025 end of the de minimis exemption and postal suspensions abroad.

title: OPPORTUNITY: The Peace Prize That Isn't Nobel
text: A football body has a new trophy and one obvious winner. It also needs you to host a draw and sign an agreement on visas.

options.label: Accept the trophy, then fix the visas
options.result: A real visa deal, a real trophy and a real standing ovation. The trophy is heavy. You checked.

ignore.text: The trophy went to a very nice goalkeeper.

inspiredBy: The December 2025 FIFA Peace Prize presented to the president at the World Cup draw.

title: OPPORTUNITY: Ceasefire With Flags
text: A regional ceasefire needs a signing ceremony. The negotiators did the work. They would like a famous chairman and a good chair.

options.label: Chair the ceremony
options.result: A real ceasefire, signed by real leaders, with your picture in every front row. You found it unseemly. You stayed.

ignore.text: The ceremony was run by a mid-sized Egyptian chair.

inspiredBy: The October 2025 Gaza ceasefire summit at Sharm el-Sheikh.

title: OPPORTUNITY: Route 47
text: Two neighbouring countries want a trade corridor and a peace paper. They have asked if it could carry your name on the road signs.

options.label: Sign the deal, and the signs
options.result: A real corridor, a real peace declaration, and a sign that reads your name in a font you approved.

ignore.text: The road was named after a local bus.

inspiredBy: The August 2025 Armenia and Azerbaijan peace declaration and the planned "Trump Route".

title: OPPORTUNITY: Curtain Call
text: A national arts venue needs a new board, and a new chairman. The board would like to call it something with your name in it.

options.label: Take the chair, keep the lights on
options.result: The venue got a budget, a board and a new sign. It now says your name above a very old stage.

ignore.text: The venue kept its old name, out of laziness.

inspiredBy: The 2025 takeover of the Kennedy Center board and later renaming proposals.

title: OPPORTUNITY: Investment Fund With A Bow
text: An allied government offers a vast investment pledge and a trade deal. They have even drafted a speech about you.

options.label: Accept the pledge, read the speech
options.result: A real trade deal, a real investment pledge, and a speech about your negotiation genius. You asked for a copy.

ignore.text: The pledge was declared a cultural treasure and filed away.

inspiredBy: The July 2025 US-Japan trade deal and its $550 billion investment pledge.

title: OPPORTUNITY: The Institute Of Peace And You
text: Two African neighbours want to sign a peace accord in Washington. The host building could use a nicer name, and you could use a building.

options.label: Host the signing
options.result: A real accord. A real building. A real plaque, hung before the ink was dry.

ignore.text: The accord was signed in a conference room that nobody enjoyed.

inspiredBy: The December 2025 DRC and Rwanda accord signed in Washington at the renamed peace institute.

title: OPPORTUNITY: The Gold Card
text: A new residency scheme would raise money for the Treasury and arrive in a very shiny package. Aides say it is "mostly legal".

options.label: Sign the order, hold the card
options.result: A real revenue line, and a card made of something that gleams. The Treasury asked what it was made of.

ignore.text: The scheme was sold to a small island.

inspiredBy: The September 2025 "Gold Card" visa executive order.

title: OPPORTUNITY: Banquet At The Castle
text: A monarch has invited you to a state visit with carriages, a banquet and a long speech in your honour. Some trade talks are attached.

options.label: Attend, and sign the tech pact
options.result: A real tech deal and a real banquet. The carriage was gilded and you asked who ordered it.

ignore.text: The banquet was held for a visiting goat.

inspiredBy: The September 2025 state visit to the UK and the technology agreement signed.

title: OPPORTUNITY: The Gulf Welcome Mat
text: Three wealthy governments have laid out the red carpet and a series of investment pledges. One of them has a very large aeroplane.

options.label: Fly out and sign everything
options.result: Real investment pledges, real handshakes and a real aeroplane. The aeroplane has a gold trim. You noticed.

ignore.text: The trip was covered by a state broadcaster, and by itself.

inspiredBy: The May 2025 Gulf tour with investment pledges and a gifted jet.

title: OPPORTUNITY: Peace In Kuala Lumpur
text: Two southeast Asian neighbours are ready to stop a border spat. They want a famous guest at the signing. The venue has air conditioning.

options.label: Attend the signing
options.result: A real ceasefire, a real accord, and a short applause for you. The room was very cool.

ignore.text: The spat was resolved by a local grandmother.

inspiredBy: The October 2025 Thailand and Cambodia ceasefire signed in Kuala Lumpur.

title: OPPORTUNITY: The Busan Handshake
text: The two largest economies would like to pause a trade war. The leaders will meet on a runway. The runway has excellent lighting.

options.label: Meet him on the runway
options.result: A real truce, real tariff cuts and a handshake that lasted 40 seconds. You counted. It was longer than his.

ignore.text: The truce was extended by a very patient clerk.

inspiredBy: The October 2025 US-China trade truce reached in South Korea.

title: OPPORTUNITY: A New Name On The List
text: Another country wants to join a regional accord. The signing is quick and the photo is excellent. Your portrait is expected.

options.label: Welcome them to the accord
options.result: A real accord widening, and a new line on the plaque. Yours is in larger letters.

ignore.text: The new member joined by email.

inspiredBy: The November 2025 announcement of Kazakhstan joining the Abraham Accords.

title: OPPORTUNITY: Parade With A Point
text: The army turns 250 and wants a parade. Veterans, lasting pensions and a long review of the equipment come with the invitation.

options.label: Review the troops, fund the pensions
options.result: A real parade and a real pension fix. The tanks were beautiful and the pensions less so. You liked both.

ignore.text: The parade was attended by a mild drizzle.

inspiredBy: The June 2025 US Army 250th anniversary parade in Washington.

title: OPPORTUNITY: A Pharmacy With Your Name
text: Drug makers will cut prices if the website that sells them carries your name. Patients get a real discount. You get a logo.

options.label: Sign the pricing deal
options.result: A real price cut, and a website with your name on it. The font is gold. You checked the font.

ignore.text: The website was named after a pharmacist.

inspiredBy: The 2025 drug-pricing deals and the TrumpRx website announced for 2026.

title: OPPORTUNITY: Credit For A Ceasefire
text: Two nuclear neighbours stopped fighting on their own and are being very quiet about who helped. You offered to say it was you.

options.label: Announce it, and call both leaders
options.result: A real ceasefire and a real phone call. You told the cameras you did it. The neighbours said "mostly".

ignore.text: The neighbours have asked for a footnote.

inspiredBy: The May 2025 India and Pakistan ceasefire and the dispute over US credit.

title: OPPORTUNITY: A Dome Above It All
text: A missile defence programme needs a name, a budget and a prominent supporter. The name on offer is shiny and has "Golden" in it.

options.label: Launch the programme, with a speech
options.result: A real defence programme and a real speech about gold. You spoke for forty minutes. The budget is a rumour.

ignore.text: The dome was cancelled for lack of a dome.

inspiredBy: The 2025 "Golden Dome" missile defence initiative announced by the White House.
